question: What will be the closing value of the FTSE 100 index (^FTSE on Yahoo Finance) on October 17, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of ^FTSE on Yahoo Finance for 2026-10-17. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't load the resolution page, but search results put the last close before the cutoff at **10,552.05 on Friday 2026-10-09**. 2026-10-17 is a Saturday, so the question resolves on the **Friday 2026-10-16 close**, five trading sessions after that last close. Searches kept returning articles dated after 2026-10-10. I left all of them out.

## 1. Resolution source
- Yahoo Finance ^FTSE daily close. 2026-10-17 is a Saturday, so the Friday **2026-10-16** close counts. I couldn't load the Yahoo history page, and Investing.com and Trading Economics also failed. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EFTSE/)
- 2026-10-09: In search snippets, the FTSE 100 closed at **10,552.05**, up about 110 points (+1.06%). It opened at 10,441.50, which was also the session low. Investing.com's table, as quoted in search results, shows the same figure. [BBN Times](https://www.bbntimes.com/global-economy/ftse-100-climbs-to-10-552-05-as-software-and-mining-stocks-rally-and-oil-eases-while-telecoms-slide-on-spacex-threat), [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/indices/uk-100-historical-data)
- One 24/7 Wall St. item gives a close of 13,973. That looks like an error and doesn't match any other source. [247wallst](https://247wallst.com/cards/london-led-europe-higher-with-a-1-2-close-finishing-a-step-ftse-market-bell-01m4gmsq7agby0c532jacmg7ae)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The last close (10,552) sits in the middle of the 10,000-11,000 range, about 450 points from each end. 11,000 would be above the 52-week high of 10,989.45, which was an intraday figure. [BBN Times](https://www.bbntimes.com/global-economy/ftse-100-climbs-to-10-552-05-as-software-and-mining-stocks-rally-and-oil-eases-while-telecoms-slide-on-spacex-threat)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-09: The index rose 1.06% to 10,552.05. Software and mining stocks rallied and oil eased, while telecoms fell on a SpaceX competitive threat. [BBN Times](https://www.bbntimes.com/global-economy/ftse-100-climbs-to-10-552-05-as-software-and-mining-stocks-rally-and-oil-eases-while-telecoms-slide-on-spacex-threat)
- 2026-10-08: Investing.com lists a close of about 10,441.60 (high 10,498.59, low 10,367.25). This fits with the +110-point move on 10-09. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/indices/uk-100-historical-data)
- 2026-10-07: The index fell 0.79% to 10,458.50. The 30-year gilt yield hit 6% and Asia-focused banks slid. Gilt yields and oil near $100 were the main pressures. [BBN Times](https://www.bbntimes.com/financial/ftse-100-falls-0-79-to-10-458-50-as-30-year-gilt-yield-hits-6-and-asia-focused-banks-slide), [Gokhshtein](https://gokhshtein.com/news/2026-10-07-ftse-100-falls-on-gilt-yields-oil-push-near-100)
- 2026-10-01: The index fell 1.68% to 10,428.27, its worst day since May. The UK 30-year gilt yield went above 6% for the first time since 1998. [BBN Times](https://www.bbntimes.com/global-economy/ftse-100-falls-to-10-428-27-its-worst-day-since-may-as-the-30-year-gilt-yield-breaks-6), [Share Talk](https://www.share-talk.com/ftse-100-falls-1-7-as-uk-30-year-gilt-yield-breaks-6/)
- Week to 2026-10-02: Trump rejected an Iranian offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and Brent briefly neared $108. US 10-year Treasury yields reached about 5.34%, the highest since 2002. [Corfe Capital](https://1trueinvesting.substack.com/p/this-week-on-the-ftse-2-october-2026)

## 4. Base rates and variation
- 2026-09-30: Q3 closed at 10,606 (+1% for the quarter). September fell about 2%. [ii.co.uk](https://www.ii.co.uk/analysis-commentary/best-and-worst-ftse-100-stocks-q3-2026-ii540457)
- 2026-08-31: August closed around 10,767. [ii.co.uk](https://www.ii.co.uk/analysis-commentary/uk-stock-market-winners-and-losers-august-2026-ii540146)
- 2026-07-29: The index set an intraday record of 10,951.06. A later record of about 10,978.87 intraday and a 10,972.06 close was reported, but I couldn't confirm the date. [La Libre](https://www.lalibre.be/dernieres-depeches/2026/07/29/la-bourse-de-londres-touche-un-nouveau-record-et-sapproche-des-11000-points-WFP432S2MFDORNCRKSYP7FSORY/), [Share Talk](https://www.share-talk.com/ftse-100-hits-fresh-record-high-as-uk-market-defies-global-uncertainty/)
- Recent swings: daily moves of about 1-1.7% have been common in October (−1.68%, −0.79%, +1.06%). The 2026-09-11 week fell more than 2%. [Trading Economics](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-kingdom/stock-market/news/583082)
- My own rough estimate, not from any source: daily volatility of about 0.9-1.1% implies a one-week standard deviation of about 2-2.5%, or roughly ±210-260 points around 10,550. The range was about 10,400-10,990 from July to early October.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the FTSE 100 close for this date.
- I found no published analyst point target for mid-October 2026.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-10-16
- Gilt market: the 30-year yield is near 6%, and markets are positioning ahead of the UK Budget. The Budget date comes from a source dated after the cutoff. It points to 2026-10-28, after resolution, but trading ahead of it may still move gilts and domestic stocks. [Corfe Capital](https://1trueinvesting.substack.com/p/this-week-on-the-ftse-2-october-2026)
- Oil and Iran: talks over the Strait of Hormuz are moving Brent (about $100-108), which drives BP, Shell and the wider index. [Corfe Capital](https://1trueinvesting.substack.com/p/this-week-on-the-ftse-2-october-2026)
- UK data I would expect in the week of 10-12, but haven't confirmed in a 2026 calendar: labour market figures and monthly GDP for August, usually mid-month.
- US: September CPI and the start of Q3 bank earnings usually fall in mid-October. I couldn't confirm the exact 2026 dates.
